reviews.body:
LGTM, thanks.

I checked the explicit half-average formulation against the preserved HTML row and §1 of the manuscript in #7305. The positive-distance denominator is |C|(|V|−1), and distances are taken in the ambient tree. Independently reconstructing the 41-vertex witness gives centers {4,5}, four leaf/support components, average 321/80, and a six-vertex total dominating set, so the bound fails by 1/160.

The pinned proof and exact-statement audit match these definitions and quantifiers. Their documented author-workflow certificate uses the PR’s Lean/Mathlib pins; I inspected it but did not independently rerun the external proof.
